records.licence: MIT root LICENSE read (1,069 bytes) AND NOTICE.md read (1,422 bytes). The root MIT covers first-party work only. Carve-outs confirmed to exist outside the LICENSE file, including a COMMERCIAL TYPEFACE committed under the owner's own Dinamo EULA: nothing under public/fonts, public/brand or docs/licenses may be reused.
records.readDepth: src/sim/armor.js read in full this session (590 lines, 21,262 B, sha256 d8b1acbac56cf8a1bfd5a52884ccb74a67f9f07dfb2ef2991ab3b94d07748150); src/sim/ballistics.js read in full (276 lines, 10,838 B, sha256 d8ad010e310a43cccb3851fd76414b3a7e935ca7de13b897a461427bed7eab3c); pinned tree enumerated; play site + LICENSE + NOTICE.md per phase-1 lane.
records.method: Plate-level armour resolution: a world-space shell segment is transformed into four rigid frames (hull, turret, gun-follow, barrel), each the exact inverse of the visual root's transform so hitboxes track the rendered attitude, then intersected against convex quad plates and module boxes for ordered hits. Penetration is interpolated against flight distance (penAtDistanceMm).
records.sourceLines: armor.js lines 9-20 (frame definitions), 98-131 (frame matrices), 138-146 (segment localisation); ballistics.js lines 187-199 (penetration vs distance), 63-92 (ballistic gun lay).
records.compatibility: Independent MIT-licensed implementation. Resolver models the core: four-frame localisation, front-face-only convex quads, AABB module box, ordered hits, pen@distance interpolation, 2-sigma-clamped dispersion. NOT modelled: damage normalisation tables, module rolls, ERA spend, track prisms, spotting, physics, destructibles.
records.limitation: Delivered as an honest subset: thickness/cos(impact) vs pen@distance. No damage normalisation, module rolls, ERA, track prisms, spotting, physics or destructible battlefields. Lab shells hit at ~3 m so interpolated pen always clamps to pen100; the curve itself is unit-checked.
records.cpuCheck: group-b-manifest.test.ts source 20: pen curve clamps (180@<=100m, 160@550m, 140@>=1000m); 600 driven frames yield >=4 shells with ordered plate hits and pen+bounce resolutions matching /^(glacis|rear|turretFront|turretSide):(pen|bounce)@Ndeg$|^ammo:module$/; builds/advances/disposes clean with deterministic twin.

records.method: Deformation as persistent accumulating state: ping-ponged float targets with no clear, copy or readback; a fixed world-metre window snapped to texel boundaries so the field does not swim, addressed toroidally so following the subject is free; one shared brush write path for every effect; recovery BANKED and spent in discrete steps because a per-frame decay is below one ULP of a half-float store.

records.limitation: No GPU pass, no float-render-target capability gate, no snow shading, compression or berm model.
